title: Omaha to Bozeman, a family of four, the week before Christmas
covers: Long drive with one night; family with two children; thirsty car; winter pass; no nonstop (one connection); medium to small airport; parking; two checked bags; rental at the destination; crosses a time zone

fare.source: southwest.com route page (Basic fare, via Denver); length from DOT schedules, December 2025

rental.source: Kayak, BZN December average (start not used: own car)

time.what: Seven 15-minute stops with children, about every 2½ hours
Two lunch stops, 45 minutes each with children; dinner is after checking in, off the road
Getting off the road, checking in, and loading the car in the morning
Weather slowdown over Bozeman Pass in December

cost.what: Gas: 590.5 mi in NE, IA, and SD ÷ 24 mpg × $4.145, plus 390 mi in WY and MT ÷ 24 × $4.439

notes: Southwest has no nonstop on this route, so DOT has no record for the pair; `schedule` and `reliability` are null, and the fare carries the itinerary's scheduled length (267 minutes, the average of each day's shortest connection in December 2025) and one stop.

The shortest connection is usually the 6:25 a.m. from Omaha. The next one, at 10:40 a.m., takes about 85 minutes longer. The engine doesn't model when flights leave, so it can't tell a family which one fits.

Of the 31 days' shortest connections in December 2025, 3 missed the Denver connection and were rebooked the same day, and 3 couldn't be completed that day; those 3 are left out of the average, so it runs slightly short.
The 2:15 p.m. arrival time in Bozeman is on Omaha's clock, an hour ahead of Bozeman's.
Kayak, Hertz, and Cheapflights gave $135, $169, and $231 as Bozeman's December daily rental average. Kayak's is used; it's the biggest swing in this trip's cost.
The Basic fare is the lowest shown for one traveler. Four seats at that price on one flight isn't guaranteed this close to the holidays.
The route crosses US 212 through rural northeast Wyoming and southeast Montana, with long gaps between services in winter. That's for Our take to weigh, not the numbers.
The family parks at OMA for eight days, until the drive home after Christmas; only the outbound trip is compared.
